references.text: Jesus heals a paralyzed man, and this demonstrates his authority to forgive sins, which is also the point in Mark 2:11.
As in Mark, Jesus here shows his power over physical ailments by healing a woman, underscoring his divine authority.
Jesus commands a sick man to stand up and walk, similar to what he says in Mark 2:11, demonstrating his power to heal.
This verse speaks of God who heals all your diseases, which can be seen as a parallel to Jesus' healing actions in the NT.
